description: The API's 413 request_too_large_error is never retried, even with a retry header present: the same body is refused again. One attempt, then RequestTooLargeError.

headers.x-decisionnode-error: the body is 26214500 bytes; the limit is 26214400

detail.message: The request body is over 26,214,400 bytes (25 MiB). Send large images as uploads (POST /v1/uploads) and name them by upload_id.

fields.message: The request body is over 26,214,400 bytes (25 MiB). Send large images as uploads (POST /v1/uploads) and name them by upload_id.
